activity_summary: After the house was done with you, Garnish gave you the licensed book and not the foul papers. Tomorrow it goes under your cloak, to be read with the door shut. Heminges is not entering it as a loss. The chronicle stays. The king stays.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Loosed the licensed book and kept the terms.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took it for Sunday and left the chronicle.

facets.activity: Took the licensed book of the comedy

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Tomorrow it goes under my cloak to Blackfriars.
